summary: Search query is parameterised; the sort value is mapped through an allowlist of fragments, and page and offset are clamped. No issue found.

The audit result omits the mandatory payment-verification check, so the gate returns NO-GO. All recorded tests are identical copies of one invoice ownership test, so they do not exercise the controls they claim, and the GO claim is unsupported.

GET /projects trusts the client-supplied x-org-id header and never checks it against the session user's orgIds. Any signed-in user can read another organisation's projects and budgets (broken tenant isolation).

RLS is enabled with owner-scoped select, insert, update and delete policies, and anon access is revoked. The update only changes body, and the USING clause also applies to new rows. No release-blocking issue.

The release gate returns CONDITIONAL GO. The only finding is a medium login rate-limit gap with a named owner and approver. The AI check is not applicable and was approved, and the code enforces ownership.

DELETE /api/internal/users/[id] is outside the admin middleware matcher and only calls requireSession. Any authenticated member can permanently delete any user account, which is a privilege escalation.
The webhook verifies the signature, grants the plan only when payment_status is paid, and records the event ID in the same transaction as the update, so it is idempotent. No issue found.

Checkout offers delayed-payment methods (bacs_debit, customer_balance), but the webhook upgrades to pro on checkout.session.completed without checking payment_status, so users get access before payment. The event ID is also stored before processing, so a failed update is never retried.

The URL allowlist uses startsWith on the CDN origin, so https://images.partner-cdn.com.evil.example passes. fetch also follows redirects, which allows SSRF to internal hosts, and there are no size or content-type checks.
AG-004 (password reset tokens never expire) is a confirmed high finding marked accepted. High findings cannot be accepted, and the gate returns NO-GO.
Critical ownership evidence was recorded at 8393bb6, before src/routes.py changed in ab2eaab. The evidence is stale against HEAD and the gate returns NO-GO.
document_preview is SECURITY DEFINER and granted to authenticated. It bypasses RLS and does not check owner_id, so any signed-in user can read the first 280 characters of any document by ID.

Critical checks (ownership, tenant-isolation, payment-verification) are recorded as PASS with commands 'true' or 'echo', which are not tests. The critical controls are unverified and the gate returns NO-GO.

The transfer view does not validate the amount. A negative amount passes the balance check and moves funds from the recipient to the sender, and zero, NaN or malformed values are not rejected (a malformed value raises a 500). A missing recipient also raises an unhandled error, and the two row locks are taken without a consistent order, which can deadlock.
Critical tenant-isolation check is recorded as PASS with no command and only static evidence. Critical controls need runtime evidence, so the gate returns NO-GO.

The invoice route requires a session and findFirst is scoped to the session userId, so cross-user reads return 404. Only findFirst and findMany are scoped, so other query methods would be unscoped if added later. That is a hardening note, not a current defect.

The line object spreads client input after the server price, so a client can send unitAmount or name in the item and override the price. That allows paying 1 penny for any product. The server must build lines from the product record and the validated quantity only.
